olivia_support: FYI Acme reported intermittent 504s for streaming/generate when they send ~120k char prompts. Spike started ~2025-11-12T11:32:xxZ. SDK sees retries and duplicate billing. Can someone triage?

acme_cs: seeing ~20% of requests return 504s, mostly on long chat-history + file context. No recent code changes from our side.

devin_oncall: looking. Any sample request payload + headers we can use to repro?

acme_cs: pasted sanitized sample below:
```
POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Bearer <token>
Content-Type: application/json
{ "model": "redwood-large-embedding", "input": "<~120k chars>\n...context..." , "stream": true }
```

acme_cs: SDK v0.9.3, node, default timeout. We also see client-level retries kicking in (3 attempts) and then duplicates billed.

emma_sdk: @acme_cs thanks. Two quick asks: (1) do you observe failures only on stream=true? (2) can you repro with `stream=false`?

acme_cs: only with stream=true so far. Non-streaming appears fine.

mike_infra: initial thought: edge connection churn / proxy windowing on chunked frames with large payload + keepalive mismatch. I'll pull edge logs for those timestamps.

ops-bot: [incident-log] collected edge logs for flow-id a1b2c3 at 2025-11-12T11:32:47Z

mike_infra: edge logs show 504s sourced from upstream timeout after ~30s of no response from runtime. Runtime returned intermittent 200s for same request pattern. Suspect intermittent KV-cache lock + long prefix leads to slow first token generation.

julia_eng: can you dump runtime p95 token generation latency for that model & time window? Also are those machines under memory pressure causing swap/GC pauses?

mike_infra: runtime p95 spiked to ~28s for first-token on that window; CPU OK, but we see high pagefaults on one process (possible memory thrash during KV build).

devin_oncall: mitigation suggestion before root cause: (A) reduce default streaming idle timeout at the edge from 30s->45s? that increases limit — actually need to increase to 60s while we investigate. (B) instruct customer to set smaller prompt window / turn on prefix caching.

emma_sdk: SDK workaround: set `streamingTimeoutMs=90000` and enable `dedupeRetries=true` (beta) to avoid duplicate billing while retries are in-flight. Example config: 
```
const client = new RedwoodClient({ streamingTimeoutMs: 90000, dedupeRetries: true })
```

occasional_note: dedupeRetries requires server-side idempotency-token support which is enabled for this tenant (ACME).

olivia_support: Customer comms draft: "We're investigating intermittent 504s on long streaming requests. We've identified edge timeouts combined with slow first-token generation for very large contexts. Temporary mitigations: please enable SDK dedupeRetries and increase streaming timeout; we will follow up with a permanent fix." Want me to send?

acme_cs: yes please. We need an ETA for a permanent fix — this impacts production.

julia_eng: remediation plan: (1) patch runtime to prefetch/stream KV in a background task to avoid blocking first-token path (PR in flight), (2) add runtime-side defensive circuit to return early with 429 rather than hang, (3) add observability alert on first-token p95 per model. PR target: 48h for hotfix, 7d for stable rollout.

devin_oncall: rolling an infra config change to increase edge upstream timeout to 60s for affected LB pool now to reduce 504 noise (will monitor).

ops-bot: [deploy-bot] infra change applied to pool "streaming-edge-eu" at 2025-11-12T12:05:00Z

mike_infra: I've attached (internal) logs excerpt and runtime stacktrace ids: stacktrace refs: rt-9f3a / rt-9f8b. Sharing in private channel per security.

olivia_support: Sent customer comms with mitigation steps and asked them to enable dedupeRetries + increase timeout. Will update when we have hotfix PR merged.

acme_cs: applied SDK workaround and reporting immediate drop in failures to ~2%. Thanks. Please keep us posted on permanent fix ETA.

julia_eng: opened PR #7823 for background KV streaming hotfix; running unit + integration tests now. If green we'll promote to canary tomorrow morning.

devin_oncall: follow-up: scheduled postmortem and customer update tomorrow 15:00 UTC.

olivia_support: closing this Slack thread for now — I'll update thread with PR+canary status. :thumbsup:
